issues.title: Null fragments, local silence and exposure are distinct
issues.evidence: ARCS_MODEL /arcs/0/hook and /arcs/0/map/sites/0/visible propose fragments driving a10-ft acoustic suppression zone. Accepted EPI08–14 gives Null exposure only to an explicitly authored field identity/boundary/clock; a realm name, glow or fragment label alone is not exposure.
issues.requestedDisposition: Decide explicitly whether each arc site has an actual Residual Null field. If none, print that; if NEW exposure is intended, provide field identity, geometry, clock, first failure and actual purge access without rewriting accepted Null. Preserve the original weaponized-silence premise and distinguish audible V/communication blockage from blanket antimagic.
issues.requiredWorkedCase: Use actual elapsed site time across exit/reentry and compare sound-only zone against an explicitly authored exposure field, including real verbal and nonverbal interfaces.

issues.title: Damage-root ownership and mechanism hazards
issues.evidence: Accepted Null flags roots at creation only when the actual dealer is a character with unsuppressed Veil. Transfers preserve the flag; independent companion attacks and new reflection roots use their actual dealer. Arc machinery has its own force, bolt, cage and loft hazards.
issues.requestedDisposition: Name actual dealers/roots where necessary. Do not label all Null-themed damage nonlethal. Preserve existing Root/transfer rules and independent non-damage support, source-expiry and cost events.
issues.requiredWorkedCase: Trace one Veiled-character attack, one independent construct bolt and one triggered site hazard, with explicit dealer/flag, recipient life branch and any sharing; no controller or fragment-name inference.

issues.title: Xi cancellation is spell-specific
issues.evidence: Accepted Xi requires a single ongoing spell-effect target branch, actual caster and selected target consent, Action/range and an item-bound charge. Arc controls, silence machines, patent obligations and CF-pattern machinery are not automatically ongoing spells.
issues.requestedDisposition: Keep the relic legal where all spell predicates hold; explain why ordinary machinery or an agreement has no cancellable spell branch. Never broaden it into a universal machine/contract switch or grant charge reset on travel.
issues.requiredWorkedCase: Show one ineligible machine/contract attempt with correct Action/charge consequence and one eligible actual source-bound spell branch if the supplied source set contains one; otherwise explain the conditional legal interface without inventing a spell.

issues.title: Mirror save benefit and finite reformation
issues.evidence: Accepted Mirror affects the next WIS save within24 elapsed hours, after actual cancellation/rerolls; final failure shatters it, and CH12 supplies only one lifetime repair using the three actual tabs. Arc saves, long voyages and annual clocks cannot duplicate these resources.
issues.requestedDisposition: Retain actual save type, pending-benefit consumption, expiry and final-result shattering. An ability check, CON hazard save or calendar deadline is not a WIS save. No arc site silently creates repair stock or a second Sentinel.
issues.requiredWorkedCase: Trace an eligible WIS save and an ineligible check/CON save, then an unused24-hour expiry or final failed WIS save, preserving the same item and repair opportunity.

issues.title: Glove, mask confession and antidote keep narrow scope
issues.evidence: Accepted Glove requires real language/visibility and current sincere stance; it is not a loyalty/motive detector. The mask-confession Action purges only Null Veil under its vow/communication predicate. Antidote uses actual finite ingredients and cures only Null Veil.
issues.requestedDisposition: Do not treat these as proof of contract compliance, automatic translation, compelled confession, mechanical deactivation, general poison/disease cures or permission to mint plant/flame-water stock. Preserve informed choice in the envoy scene.
issues.requiredWorkedCase: Run a concrete envoy or salvage interaction with a real language/stance boundary, one actual purge and exact inventory/custody consequences; no knowledge, machine or contract reset follows.
